title: What is Infrastructure as Code with Terraform?
description: Learn how infrastructure as code lets you safely build, change, and manage infrastructure. Try Terraform.
summary_ja: TerraformによるInfrastructure as Codeの概念を学ぶ入門チュートリアル。

title: Install Terraform
description: Install Terraform on Mac, Linux, or Windows by downloading the binary or using a package manager (Homebrew or Chocolatey). Then create a Docker container locally by following a quick-start tutorial to check that Terraform installed correctly.
summary_ja: Terraformをインストールし、Dockerコンテナ作成で動作確認する。

title: Create infrastructure
description: Authenticate to AWS and create infrastructure with Terraform. Write and validate Terraform configuration, initialize a configuration directory, and plan and apply a configuration to create infrastructure.
summary_ja: AWSに認証し、Terraformのinit/plan/applyでインフラを作成する。

title: Manage infrastructure
description: Update your infrastructure configuration and apply changes with Terraform. Add variables and output values to your configuration. Use a module to reuse configuration.
summary_ja: AWSインフラの変更適用と変数・出力・モジュール利用を学ぶ。

title: Destroy infrastructure
description: Destroy AWS infrastructure managed by Terraform. Remove a resource from your configuration. Run and apply a destroy plan to remove all of your workspace's infrastructure.
summary_ja: Terraform管理下のAWSインフラをdestroyプランで削除する。

title: Collaborate using HCP Terraform
description: Configure Terraform to store state in HCP Terraform. Add a `cloud` block to your configuration to configure your HCP Terraform integration.
summary_ja: cloudブロックでHCP Terraformにstateを保存し共同作業する。

title: Build infrastructure
description: Initialize, plan and apply configuration in a directory to create an Azure resource group. Inspect the Terraform state to discover the group ID once Terraform creates it.
summary_ja: TerraformでAzureリソースグループを作成しstateを確認する。

title: Change infrastructure
description: Add tags to an existing Azure resource group to learn how Terraform manages infrastructure changes. Edit Terraform configuration, then plan and apply the change.
summary_ja: Azureリソースグループにタグを追加し変更管理を学ぶ。

title: Destroy infrastructure
description: Destroy Azure infrastructure managed by Terraform. Evaluate the plan and confirm the destruction.
summary_ja: Terraform管理下のAzureインフラをプラン確認のうえ削除する。

title: Define input variables
description: Declare your Azure resource group name as a variable. Reference the variable in Terraform configuration. Define a variable using command line flags or default values.
summary_ja: Azureリソースグループ名を入力変数として宣言・参照する。

title: Query data with output values
description: Declare output values to display an Azure resource group ID. Display all outputs and query specific outputs.
summary_ja: 出力値でAzureリソースグループIDを表示・照会する。

title: Store remote state
description: Configure Terraform to store state in HCP Terraform. Add a remote state block directly to configuration or set an environment variable to load remote state configuration when Terraform initializes.
summary_ja: HCP Terraformにリモートstateを保存する構成を学ぶ。

title: Build infrastructure
description: Authenticate to Google Cloud and create a VPC network. Write and validate Terraform configuration, initialize a configuration directory, and plan and apply a configuration to create infrastructure.
summary_ja: Google Cloudに認証しTerraformでVPCネットワークを作成する。

title: Change infrastructure
description: Add a Google Compute Engine VM instance to a VPC by referencing the VPC in its configuration using arguments. Modify the instance by adding tags, and implement a destructive change.
summary_ja: VPCにCompute Engine VMを追加しタグ変更や破壊的変更を行う。

title: Destroy infrastructure
description: Destroy Google Cloud infrastructure managed by Terraform. Evaluate the plan and confirm the destruction.
summary_ja: Terraform管理下のGoogle Cloudインフラを削除する。

title: Define input variables
description: Declare your GCP credential location, infrastructure region and zone as variables. Reference these variables in Terraform configuration. Define them using command line flags, environment variables, .tfvars files or default values.
summary_ja: GCPの認証情報・リージョン・ゾーンを変数として定義する。

title: Query data with output values
description: Output the public IP of your Google Cloud instance using output variables. Read about using outputs to query specific data from Terraform state.
summary_ja: 出力変数でGoogle CloudインスタンスのパブリックIPを取得する。

title: Build infrastructure
description: Use Terraform to deploy a Docker container, format your Terraform configuration, and review your infrastructure state.
summary_ja: TerraformでDockerコンテナをデプロイしstateを確認する。

title: Change infrastructure
description: Modify Docker container configuration to use a different external port. Plan and apply the changes to re-provision a new container that reflects the new configuration. Learn how Terraform handles infrastructure change management.
summary_ja: Dockerコンテナの外部ポートを変更し再プロビジョニングする。

title: Destroy infrastructure
description: Destroy the Docker container you created in the previous tutorials. Evaluate the plan and confirm the destruction.
summary_ja: 作成したDockerコンテナをプラン確認のうえ削除する。

title: Define input variables
description: Declare your Docker container name as a variable. Reference the variable in Terraform configuration. Define variables using command line flags, environment variables, .tfvars files or default values.
summary_ja: Dockerコンテナ名を入力変数として宣言・参照する。

title: Query data with outputs
description: Declare output values to display a Docker containers name and ID. Display all outputs and query specific outputs. Define what data stored in Terraform state is relevant to the operator or end user.
summary_ja: 出力値でDockerコンテナの名前とIDを表示・照会する。

title: Build infrastructure
description: Authenticate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, and create a Virtual Cloud Network. Write, format and validate a Terraform configuration. Plan and apply the configuration to create an VCN OCI resource.
summary_ja: OCIに認証しTerraformでVirtual Cloud Networkを作成する。

title: Change infrastructure
description: Add a subnet to your Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) VCN. Modify the subnet display name and plan changes to update the resource in place. Learn how Terraform handles infrastructure change management.
summary_ja: OCI VCNにサブネットを追加しインプレース更新を学ぶ。

title: Destroy infrastructure
description: Destroy the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Virtual Cloud Network (VCN) and subnet you created in the previous tutorials. Evaluate the plan and confirm the destruction.
summary_ja: OCIのVCNとサブネットをプラン確認のうえ削除する。

title: Define input variables
description: Declare your OCI region and compartment ID as variables. Reference the variable in Terraform configuration. Define variables using .tfvars files or default values.
summary_ja: OCIリージョンとコンパートメントIDを変数として定義する。

title: Query data with outputs
description: Declare output values to display the status and CIDR block of your OCI VCN. Display all outputs and query specific outputs. Define what data stored in Terraform state is relevant to the operator or end user.
summary_ja: 出力値でOCI VCNのステータスとCIDRブロックを表示する。

title: Sign up for HCP Terraform
description: Create a new HCP Terraform account and organization. Learn how to collaborate on your configuration and scale your Terraform workflows.
summary_ja: HCP Terraformのアカウントと組織を作成する。

title: Trigger HCP Terraform runs from VCS changes
description: Learn how to create workspaces from VCS repositories and trigger runs with code changes.
summary_ja: VCSリポジトリからワークスペースを作り変更でrunを起動する。

title: Organize workspaces with projects and variable sets
description: Learn how to use projects to manage workspaces and how to create variable sets to share values.
summary_ja: プロジェクトでワークスペースを管理し変数セットを共有する。

title: Link dependent workspaces
description: Learn how to link HCP Terraform workspaces with run triggers and use the tfe_outputs data source to share information between them.
summary_ja: runトリガーとtfe_outputsで依存ワークスペースを連携する。

title: Run a refresh-only operation
description: Learn how to perform refresh-only operations to fix resource drift.
summary_ja: refresh-only操作でリソースのドリフトを修正する。

title: Destroy resources and workspaces
description: Destroy the resources in an HCP Terraform workspace, then delete the workspace using the web UI.
summary_ja: HCP Terraformワークスペースのリソースとワークスペース自体を削除する。

title: Define infrastructure with Terraform resources
description: Create an EC2 instance, then use the Terraform Registry to create a security group to make it publicly accessible. Learn how Terraform resources define infrastructure as code through arguments, attributes, and dependencies.
summary_ja: EC2とセキュリティグループを題材にリソース定義の基本を学ぶ。

title: Customize Terraform configuration with variables
description: Use Terraform input variables, including lists, maps, strings, and booleans, to parameterize your Terraform configuration.
summary_ja: リスト・マップ・文字列・真偽値の入力変数で構成をパラメータ化する。

title: Protect sensitive input variables
description: Protect sensitive values from accidental exposure using Terraform sensitive input variables. Provision a web application with Terraform, and mark input variables as sensitive to restrict when Terraform prints them out to the console.
summary_ja: sensitive変数で機微な値のコンソール露出を防ぐ。

title: Simplify Terraform configuration with locals
description: Create Terraform local values with expressions to name resources and reduce configuration duplication. Then, combine local values and variables.
summary_ja: ローカル値と式で命名や重複を整理し変数と組み合わせる。

title: Output data from Terraform
description: Use output values to export data about the resources Terraform manages. Hide sensitive output values.
summary_ja: 出力値で管理リソースのデータを公開し機微な出力を隠す。

title: Query data sources
description: Use a data source to configure an EC2 instance with an appropriate AMI for the current region. Use a remote state data source to share data between Terraform projects and to support multiple availability zones.
summary_ja: データソースでAMI取得やリモートstate共有を行う。

title: Create resource dependencies
description: Create an implicit dependency between an EC2 instance and its Elastic IP using variable interpolation. Create explicit dependencies on an S3 Bucket and SQS Queue with depends_on. Learn how Terraform creates independent resources in parallel.
summary_ja: 暗黙・明示の依存関係と並列作成の仕組みを学ぶ。

title: Manage similar resources with count
description: Create a VPC with a load balancer and EC2 instances. Use the `count` meta-argument to provision multiple resources from the same configuration.
summary_ja: countでVPC・ロードバランサー・EC2を複数プロビジョニングする。

title: Manage similar resources with for each
description: Provision similar infrastructure components by iterating over a data structure with the for_each argument. Duplicate an entire VPC including a load balancer and multiple EC2 instances for each project defined in a map.
summary_ja: for_eachでプロジェクトごとにVPC一式を複製する。

title: Perform dynamic operations with functions
description: Use templatefile and lookup functions to generate dynamic user data for an EC2 instance and find a region-specific AMI.
summary_ja: templatefileやlookup関数で動的なuser dataやAMI選択を行う。

title: Create dynamic expressions
description: Use locals to assign expressions to variables for reuse, conditionals to declare if/then scenarios, and the splat expression to return attributes from complex value types.
summary_ja: 条件式やsplat式など動的式の書き方を学ぶ。

title: Lock and upgrade provider versions
description: Manage your provider versions using the dependency lock file. Use version constraints to filter provider versions compatible with your configuration. Update your lock file to use a new provider version.
summary_ja: 依存ロックファイルとバージョン制約でプロバイダを管理する。

title: Troubleshoot Terraform
description: Interpret and fix a Terraform configuration with common configuration language errors and deploy an EC2 instance with security groups in AWS. Learn best practices for logging application errors and reporting bugs.
summary_ja: 典型的な構成言語エラーを解釈・修正しEC2をデプロイする。

title: Manage Terraform versions
description: Update an existing configuration to work with a newer version of Terraform. Use the required_version setting to pin the Terraform versions for your projects. Manage different versions of Terraform across your team.
summary_ja: required_versionでTerraformバージョンを固定・管理する。

title: Use configuration to move resources
description: Use the configuration-driven workflow to change Terraform resource IDs. Refactor configuration to move resources into modules using the `moved` block.
summary_ja: movedブロックでリソースをモジュールへ移すリファクタリングを行う。

title: Validate modules with custom conditions
description: Add a precondition and postcondition to a module to validate downstream usage, ensuring that DNS and EBS support are enabled, and that the appropriate number of subnets are configured.
summary_ja: precondition/postconditionでモジュール利用条件を検証する。

title: Customize modules with object attributes
description: Refactor a local module to organize related attributes with objects and make some attributes optional for module users.
summary_ja: オブジェクト型でモジュール属性を整理し任意属性を可能にする。

title: Use checks to validate infrastructure
description: Use check blocks to define and evaluate assertions about your environment and resources.
summary_ja: checkブロックで環境やリソースへのアサーションを定義する。

title: Write Terraform Tests
description: Write tests to validate the behavior of your Terraform module configuration.
summary_ja: Terraformテストでモジュール構成の振る舞いを検証する。

title: Configure Terraform providers
description: Source, version, configure, and authenticate Terraform providers. Use provider aliases for multiple configurations across regions and configure provider inheritance in child modules.
summary_ja: プロバイダの取得・認証・エイリアス・子モジュール継承を学ぶ。

title: Invoke actions with Terraform
description: Provision infrastructure with Terraform, then add an action to your configuration. Invoke the action from the CLI and from a trigger when another resource is updated.
summary_ja: TerraformのactionをCLIやトリガーから呼び出す。

title: Modules overview
description: Read about how Terraform modules make configuration easier to organize, understand, reuse, and share. Learn about the directory structure of a module, and how to call them.
summary_ja: モジュールの役割・ディレクトリ構造・呼び出し方を概観する。

title: Use registry modules in configuration
description: Use modules from the public Terraform Registry to define an Amazon VPC containing two EC2 instances. Select module and root input and output variables, install the modules, and apply the configuration.
summary_ja: RegistryモジュールでEC2入りVPCを構築する。

title: Build and use a local module
description: Write a local module to create an Amazon S3 bucket hosting a static website. Create a module directory, write the module configuration, variables, and outputs, and call the module from a root configuration.
summary_ja: S3静的サイト用のローカルモジュールを作成し呼び出す。

title: Share modules in the private registry
description: Import modules to share securely in HCP Terraform's free private registry. Fork an example module, tag a version-controlled release, deploy the module into the registry, and use it in a configuration.
summary_ja: HCP Terraformのプライベートレジストリでモジュールを共有する。

title: Add public providers and modules to your private registry
description: Curate modules and providers for your organization using a private registry. Track approved modules and providers for your organization's use.
summary_ja: プライベートレジストリで組織承認済みモジュール等を管理する。

title: Refactor monolithic Terraform configuration
description: Deploy development and production versions of an S3-hosted static website. Separate their configuration into files, directories, and workspaces, and explore the architectural trade-offs of each approach.
summary_ja: モノリシック構成をファイル・ディレクトリ・ワークスペースに分割する。

title: Module creation - recommended pattern
description: Learn the architectural recommendations for module creation distilled from engagements with large enterprises using Terraform. Use Terraform module best practices to scope, build, improve and consume Terraform modules.
summary_ja: 大企業事例に基づくモジュール作成の推奨パターンを学ぶ。

title: Create and use no-code modules
description: Use HCP Terraform no-code modules to let users deploy resources without writing Terraform configuration.
summary_ja: HCP Terraformのno-codeモジュールでコードなしデプロイを可能にする。

title: Import Terraform configuration
description: Use the Terraform import block to import existing resources and automatically generate configuration. Review important considerations when bringing infrastructure under Terraform management.
summary_ja: importブロックで既存リソースを取り込み構成を自動生成する。

title: Migrate state to HCP Terraform
description: Migrate a state file to HCP Terraform for secure storage and easy collaboration.
summary_ja: stateファイルをHCP Terraformへ移行し安全に保管・共有する。

title: Manage resources in Terraform state
description: Create an EC2 instance and security group, and move a resource to another state file. Remove, replace, and re-import resources to manage state and reconcile drift in your infrastructure.
summary_ja: state内のリソース移動・削除・置換・再importでドリフトを是正する。

title: Target resources
description: Apply changes to an AWS S3 bucket and bucket objects using resource targeting. Target individual resources, modules, and collections of resources to change or destroy. Explore how Terraform handles upstream and downstream dependencies.
summary_ja: リソースターゲティングでS3等の一部リソースだけを変更・削除する。

title: Manage resource drift
description: Create an AWS instance and security group. Manually change the instance to create drift in your Terraform state file. Reconcile your state drift and import your resources while avoiding downtime.
summary_ja: 手動変更で生じたドリフトをダウンタイムなしに解消する。

title: Manage resource lifecycle
description: Create an AWS instance and security group. Update your configuration with lifecycle management blocks to prevent resource deletion, create resources before destroying them, and ignore changes to specific resource attributes.
summary_ja: lifecycleブロックで削除防止や作成順序、変更無視を制御する。

title: Version remote state with the HCP Terraform API
description: Deploy an EC2 instance to an HCP Terraform workspace and use the Terraform API to interact with and update state.
summary_ja: HCP Terraform APIでリモートstateを操作・更新する。

title: Use refresh-only mode to sync Terraform state
description: Use refresh-only plans and applies to update Terraform state to match real-world infrastructure. Understand the implicit refresh behavior in Terraform plan and apply operations.
summary_ja: refresh-onlyでstateを実インフラに同期させる。

title: Develop configuration with the console
description: Use the Terraform console to inspect resources and evaluate Terraform expressions before using them in configurations. Configure an S3 bucket with an IAM role to restrict access by IP address.
summary_ja: コンソールで式を評価し、IAMロールでS3アクセスをIP制限する。

title: Initialize Terraform configuration
description: Run `terraform init` to initialize a Terraform backend, install providers, download modules, and explore the lock file and .terraform directory.
summary_ja: terraform initでバックエンド・プロバイダ・モジュールを初期化する。

title: Create a Terraform plan
description: Learn how Terraform constructs an execution plan. Export a plan with the -out flag, review the plan contents, and apply a saved plan.
summary_ja: 実行プランの生成、-outでの保存、保存済みプランの適用を学ぶ。

title: Apply Terraform configuration
description: Provision a Docker container with Terraform, introduce and handle an apply error, and perform basic troubleshooting.
summary_ja: Dockerコンテナをapplyで作成しエラー対応と基本トラブルシュートを行う。

title: Verify Terraform binary archives
description: Verify that the terraform executable is secure. Download, verify, and install HashiCorp's PGP public key. Download a Terraform archive and signed checksum. Verify that the Terraform archive matches the checksum file.
summary_ja: PGP鍵と署名付きチェックサムでTerraformアーカイブを検証する。
